newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wants avoid "chronic" deficits with Japan.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wants avoid "chronic" deficits with Japan.

text.p: President Clinton wants to avoid a return to "chronic trade deficits" between the United States and Japan, the White House said Friday as Clinton met Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto.
Japan's trade surplus with the United States rose 11.2 percent to $3.04 billion in March, the sixth consecutive month in which it had risen.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton had "made it clear that we want to keep the progress that we've seen in our trade relations going in the right direction. There's been an uptick in numbers in recent months and we want to make sure we don't go back to any period of chronic trade deficits."
